

== Original and later persona-title states ==
The printed title changed from “Black Leader” to “Juno Eclipse, Black Leader”. The lore was removed in the master. References in game text were updated. Both source images have been checked. The original has its own full card article at [[Black Leader (V)]]. Compilation dates do not establish the precise effective date of each state. The dated source-history audit remains open.
